completenessNote: Every public component/subcomponent export of @astryxdesign/core at the frozen commit has an entry; extension-package entries (@canary) carry names/paths/docs props only. Props merge the authored .doc.mjs tables with a TypeScript-checker read of each component's props type (React/StyleX types unresolved, so inherited HTML attributes and Omit<>-derived props appear only via docs). Keyboard/notes are curated from source + tests and still need behavioural verification in a browser.
